lines.en: Four hooves pace the wet sand slowly.
The wings on my back drag on the ground.
Big frame, slow gait.
Seaweed tangles in my mane.
I pace along the shoreline.
My hoofprints alternate deep and shallow.
Waves slap my legs.

lines.zh: 我不跑，跑起来会翻起沙。
lines.en: I don't run; I'd churn the sand.
My hide has a scaly sheen.
I stroll as if inspecting.
My wingtips brush lines in the sand.

lines.zh: 我走着走着，会突然停下。
lines.en: Mid-stride I sometimes stop dead.
My breath smells of the sea.
My mane hangs in wet ropes.
A horse — and yet not one.
My shadow has wings.
I stand in the shallows, still.
Rings spread from my hooves.
Folded wings look wrong on me.
Seaborn blood still runs in me.
I lower my head and lick a hoof.

lines.zh: 我的蹄子踩过湿沙，留下鳞纹。
lines.en: My hooves leave scale-patterned prints in wet sand.

lines.zh: 鬃毛一扬，咸水滴到沙上。
lines.en: A toss of my mane drops salt water on the sand.
I can see a village far off.
I wait for something to come near.
This body is heavier than before.
The wet mane is cold on my neck.
Still as a reef.
The tide has risen a little.

lines.zh: 我从鼻子里喷出一口白气。
lines.en: I blow a puff of white breath.
You can't ride me.

lines.zh: 我横过身子，挡在你面前。
lines.en: I turn broadside and block you.
Don't touch my wing.
I remember how villages smell.

lines.zh: 你身上有铁傀儡的味道吗？
lines.en: Do you smell of iron golems?
A horse with wings.
I don't eat grass now; you should know.
My eyes are brighter than before.
Back off; I dislike being crowded.
We watch each other; the water moves.
I step back; the sand gives.
My wing hangs from the blow.

lines.zh: 这一下，还不至于让我倒。
lines.en: That won't be enough to drop me.
I shake my head; water flies.
Thick hide still tears.
A low rumble leaves my throat.
Blood mixes with seawater.
Mane swinging, I turn my forequarters.
My hooves are unsteady.
The seaborn don't fall easily.
Grass? Not anymore.
Set it down and walk away.
My appetite has changed.

lines.zh: 这点诱饵，连闻都不值得。
lines.en: That bait isn't worth a sniff.
Waving it only annoys me.
That's not food I smell.
I want something else.
Don't come with your hand out.
I won't come closer.
Fodder? I haven't touched it in ages.

lines.zh: 你顶在我膝上，动不了我。
lines.en: You shove my knee and I don't shift.
One step back and the sand sinks.
My wing caught you — sorry.
Too big to dodge.
Don't stand behind me.
I look down as water runs past.
My hoof nearly caught you.
I turn to let you by.
That impact doesn't move me.
Our prints cover the sand.
My kind are rare.
Who'd come close with these wings?
I remember how it felt to run.
The seaborn don't bother with such things.
I stand alone in the water.
The tide counts as an answer.

lines.zh: 海嗣的同类之情，淡得很。
lines.en: Kin-ties among the seaborn run thin.
Maybe. Maybe not.
Everything in the sea is like this.
Stop looking this way.
I lower my head and take it.
Leather — that's useful.
I take a shard of prism light.
Light enough for me.
It fell in the water and sank.
A flick of my teeth lands it on my back.
Wet, but still usable.
I don't bend my legs; I lower my head.
I carry it a way before setting it down.
Seaweed wraps around it.
Something stirs by the village.
My eyes have locked on.
Iron golem — I know that scent.
I turn my whole body around.
The target is ashore.
My wings have opened.
You're in my range too.
I didn't come for grass.
The seaborn blood speaks.
Don't stand between us.

lines.zh: 我四蹄起落，慢慢压过去。
lines.en: Hoof by hoof, I bear down on you.
Slow, but relentless.
My wings drag; the sound is heavy.
You're blocking my front.
It retreats; I advance.
One stride of four hooves catches you.
This shore is mine.
The tide is coming in — good.
Stepping in between won't help.
Only these few steps left.

lines.zh: 垂翼先张开，前蹄才砸落。
lines.en: The drooping wings spread first; then the hooves come down.
I charge, sand and all.
A wing sweep shoves you aside.
That one will make bones creak.
Once I bite, I don't open.
My hoof lands and the ground sinks.

lines.zh: 让开，它躲不过我这一蹄。
lines.en: Move aside; it can't dodge this hoof.
No cry — just the blow.
Seaborn strength beats a horse's.
After the strike, I walk on.
I walk out of the surf.
Water drips from my mane.
My wings trail behind me.
The shore is drier than the sea.
I shake off a coat of seawater.
This beach is mine to start with.
The seaborn sent me here.
I raise my head and test the wind.
I smell a village.
My hooves sink in wet sand.
My coat singes; the smell is sharp.
Falling this hard throws up sand.
Water floods my lungs; I can't fight.
The blast shifts me sideways.

lines.zh: 箭矢扎进我鬃毛下的肩。
lines.en: An arrow bites my shoulder under the mane.
That force pins my wings.

lines.zh: 饥得四蹄打飘，走不成直线。
lines.en: Hunger makes my hooves wander off line.

lines.zh: 雷落在背上，我全身一颤。
lines.en: Lightning hits my back; I convulse.

lines.zh: 没有地，我连蹄子都用不上。
lines.en: No ground; my hooves are useless.
